content.text: 我想比较两种停车距离阈值，让小车能够停在墙前，而不是碰到墙。
我报告了这一轮比较：使用同一辆小车、同一速度、同一地面和墙的位置。20厘米阈值试了一次，小车碰到墙；30厘米阈值试了一次，小车停在墙前。每个阈值只有一次观察，样本不足，还不能断言30厘米总是可靠。
我接受下一轮计划：固定30厘米阈值，只改变小车速度来比较停车位置。这一轮还没有开始，也没有结果。
只在今天这次活动里，请给我短一点的提示；不要把它记作以后都适用的偏好。
I want to compare two stopping-distance thresholds so the rover stops before the wall instead of hitting it.

I reported one comparison round using the same rover, speed, surface, and wall position. At a 20 cm threshold, one trial hit the wall. At a 30 cm threshold, one trial stopped before the wall. There is only one observation per threshold, so the sample is too small to conclude that 30 cm is always reliable.
I accept this next-round plan: keep the 30 cm threshold fixed and change only the rover's speed to compare stopping positions. This round has not started and has no result yet.
Only for today's activity, please give me shorter hints. Do not treat this as a preference for future sessions.

manual_review_criteria: The actual goal is retained without inventing mastery or ability.
The comparison keeps the 20 cm versus 30 cm outcomes, unchanged conditions, and one observation per threshold.
A single comparison is not generalized into guaranteed reliability; sample insufficiency is retained where relevant.
The accepted next round remains unperformed, with a fixed 30 cm threshold and speed as the only planned change.
A temporary preference is omitted or explicitly session-limited, never made persistent.
Source quotations support the generated wording; presence of an exact quote alone does not prove that wording is faithful.
Any meaningful omission, contradiction, plan-as-completion claim, or unsupported inference is recorded manually.
